title: "Hearing Aid"
date: 2026-07-25

As now I'm in campus, I have songs for my commute everywhere. Three. Three whole songs for my commute to anywhere. The distances here is very less, so I'll reach the place waay before the songs get over, which is... interesting, because every time I pick up my phone to go somewhere I'm on the third song, and it reminds me that I have a travel playlist of three songs. It is an endless loop that the end reminding me to go to the beginning, and it seems very unusual, but unsurprising.
